Walk-in-interview for CMO
Friday, 27 December 2024
2555 Hits
Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital invites candidates for the walk-in-interview for the post of Casualty Medical Officer. Interested eligible candidates are requested to attend the Office of the Medical Superintendent, Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram with all original certificates including a Permanent Registration Certificate for a personal interview between 10.00 AM to 5.00 PM on weekdays. Job shall be granted on a first come first basis.
QUALIFICATION & EXPERIENCE
:
M.B.B.S. Degree with 1-year internship from recognized University. Candidates with postgraduate degree/diploma will be preferred.
Note: Age Limit: 38 years for open category and 43 for Reserve category candidate
Age and Experience can be relaxed for an exceptional and suitable candidate.
Swachhata Pakhwada - 2025
Swachhata Pakwada September 2024
